text:
maria: quick follow-up on compaction vs eviction ordering. saw p99 token spikes this morning when compactor kicked off during steady qps. need a compact plan.

aj: do we have traces?

maria: yea, trace: https://internal/trace/def456. compactor stole IO and async page fetches stalled.

kevin: timeline looks like scheduler started a global compaction while evictor was mid-scan; compactor consumed disk bandwidth and queued io.

tim: was compaction triggered by idle heuristic?

maria: scheduler triggered it under 'compact-on-idle' — idle detection misclassified tail of small batches as idle. we should tighten that.

sylvia: suggestion: never run global compaction on the fast lane. prefer per-arena compaction and only run global during maintenance windows. also add tenant-level compaction throttle.

aj: also we should surface a compactor_backpressure metric so routing can slow new incoming token work while compaction is active.

kevin: config sketch:
```
compaction:
  allowed_lanes: maintenance
  max_io_mb_s: 120
  preempt_threshold_pct: 70
  tenant_throttle: true
```

maria: plus prefer small/arena compacts over sweeping global compactions. global compaction should acquire an IO lease and yield to evictor.

sylvia: agree. evictor should be able to request IO tokens and compactor yields. make compaction_inprogress metric and a boolean.

aj: test plan: perf CI sim with mixed small/big batch traces, inject compaction, check regression alert if p99 increases >10%.

infra-bot: perf-ci queued: compaction-evict-lease-sim (run id: 2026-03-23_02)

kevin: deployment plan? canary config roll?

maria: yes. canary 5% with compaction.mode=maintenance, tenant_throttle on. monitor compaction_inprogress and p99_latency.

aj: i'll coauthor RFC follow-up and add API for compactor control + metrics.

sylvia: :thumbsup:

maria: will post RFC link when ready.
